system: Microsoft 365 (Graph: Outlook, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Excel)

scopes_needed_read: Mail.Read (app: admin consent Yes; delegated: No)
Sites.Selected (app and delegated; admin consent No per permissions reference, but admin must grant per-site access)
auth.refresh: App-only: client credentials with client secret or certificate. Delegated: auth code + refresh token.

access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: Multi-tenant Entra app registration, no review for basic use; publisher verification recommended (UNVERIFIED not fetched). Teams message export APIs are 'protected APIs': 'to use it, you must request access by completing a request form' (getAllMessages) beyond permissions and consent.
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Tenant Global Admin (or Privileged Role Admin) grants admin consent to our multi-tenant app via the admin-consent URL for the application permissions above; for SharePoint minimal access, admin grants Sites.Selected then grants our app per-site permission via POST /sites/{id}/permissions.
access_requirements.cost_to_us: Free app registration; Teams message APIs can be metered/billed (UNVERIFIED, page not fetched)
access_requirements.time_to_approval: Protected API form approval time UNVERIFIED

sandbox.how_to_get: Microsoft 365 Developer Program tenant (UNVERIFIED eligibility, not fetched)

rate_limits: Graph throttling per app/tenant (UNVERIFIED numbers; see learn.microsoft.com/graph/throttling)

events: change notifications on mail, driveItem, events, chatMessage

data_objects_to_pull: Excel workbook ranges (drive items via workbook API)
incremental_sync: Delta query per Microsoft: supported for message, event, driveItem, listItem, site, chatMessage; follow @odata.nextLink until @odata.deltaLink; 410 Gone means full resync; Outlook delta tokens have no fixed life; directory objects 7 days; OneDrive/SharePoint support token=latest.

unified_api_coverage.merge_dev: SharePoint and OneDrive absent from merge.dev/integrations fetch (unverified, page may be truncated)

blockers: Tenant admin consent required for every app-only permission
Teams messages need protected-API access request
Use Sites.Selected to avoid tenant-wide Sites.Read.All objections
